Variants.Content: Protection and local recognition support each other. Roman markets, gifts or bounded service add standing, but partners compare security against duties.
Protection and local recognition sustain Vannius. Military recognition also rests on rewards and relief; a title needs willing action. Roman gifts and bounded service can bring new duties.
